decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - It is considered that the proposed single storey rear extension, because of its position, design and appearance, is acceptable having due regard for the site characteristics of No. 6 central Avenue, is complementary to the visual amenity of the locality, and would not be detrimental to the amenities of the adjoining and neighbouring properties.  On balance, the development is in accordance with Unitary Development Plan (Adopted December 2003) policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development) of Council's Unitary Development Plan (Adopted December 2003).
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority prior to the completion of work.

Condition : 5 - The roof area of the extension hereby permitted shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of further specific permission from the Local Planning Authority.
description: Conversion of premises into pharmacy incorporating the erection of a single storey rear extension.
